entries.label: Official
entries.summary: First-party build, signed and attested by the release identity.
entries.explanation_drawer: This artifact is published by the project's own release identity and carries a verified first-party signature. It is the only origin that can carry an unqualified Stable claim.

entries.label: Vendor
entries.summary: Authored by a governed vendor or partner.
entries.explanation_drawer: A known vendor or partner authored this under a governed agreement. The origin is accountable but is not first-party, so a claim built on it narrows below Stable until first-party evidence is present.

entries.label: Community
entries.explanation_drawer: The community contributed and reviewed this artifact. It is legitimate but not first-party, so a claim built on it narrows below Stable.

entries.label: Mirrored
entries.summary: Served from a mirror of a first-party artifact.
entries.explanation_drawer: This came from a mirror copy rather than the first-party channel. The mirror's freshness stays inspectable without reaching vendor services, but a mirrored origin narrows the claim until first-party provenance is confirmed.

entries.label: Offline bundle
entries.summary: Installed from an offline bundle; origin recorded, not live-verified.
entries.explanation_drawer: This was installed from an offline bundle. Its origin is recorded but not live-verified against the channel, so the claim narrows until the origin can be reverified online.

entries.label: Side-loaded
entries.explanation_drawer: This was side-loaded outside the governed channel. The origin is shown rather than hidden, but a side-loaded artifact cannot carry a Stable claim until it is reconciled with the governed channel.

entries.label: Not provided
entries.explanation_drawer: No origin evidence was provided for this artifact. A missing origin is recorded explicitly — never left blank — and blocks any Stable claim until provenance is supplied.

entries.label: Signature verified
entries.summary: Signature and attestation verified against the release identity.
entries.explanation_drawer: The artifact's signature was checked against the release identity and a build attestation is present and valid. This is the strongest signature state.

entries.label: Signature unverified
entries.summary: A signature is present but could not be verified.
entries.explanation_drawer: A signature is present but could not be verified against a trusted key in the current context. The claim narrows until the signature verifies.

entries.label: Attestation available
entries.explanation_drawer: A build attestation is available describing how this artifact was produced. Attestation is positive evidence but does not by itself substitute for a verified signature.

entries.label: Unsigned
entries.explanation_drawer: This artifact carries no signature. An unsigned artifact narrows the claim until signing evidence is added.

entries.label: Signature invalid
entries.summary: A signature is present but failed verification.
entries.explanation_drawer: A signature is present but failed verification — the bytes do not match the claimed identity. An invalid signature blocks any Stable claim and is surfaced rather than ignored.

entries.label: Signature not provided
entries.explanation_drawer: No signature evidence was provided for this artifact. The absence is recorded explicitly and narrows the claim until signature state is supplied.
